description: This file defines a repository class for managing video like states in a video streaming app. It includes in-memory caching, refresh logic, and methods to like/unlike videos.

classes.name: LikesState
classes.description: Data class representing the like count and liked status for a video.

classes.name: VideoLikesRepository
classes.description: Repository class that manages like states, cache, and API interactions for videos.

methods.name: getCached
methods.description: Retrieves the cached LikesState for a given video ID.

methods.name: setCached
methods.description: Updates the cache with a new LikesState for a specified video ID.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest like data from the API and updates the cache.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Sends a like request to the API for a specific video.

methods.name: unlike
methods.description: Sends an unlike request to the API for a specific video.
